What does "Ith oh" mean? Good or bad for me?

I am in Cannes...had dinner with the dreaded deGuardiolas at DuCap...saw David Geffen in Eden Roc...then went to lobby
up the long gorgeous walkway- because Joanne was stalking jury president Bob De Niro for a pair of tickets for Woody's
opening night. (Wood man turned her down flat after having met her once that Richard LeFrak!)
Anyway...being the good guy I am...I led her to Bobby D. hiding behind a pillar in the bar with wife Grace...we hung out
with Bob...made him laugh and low and behold Grace came up with a pair for PUSHY Joanne. Her persistence makes me
look like a piker.

What is going on with lawyer and brother. Do not understand.

Thrilled to be here. Excited to write. Have sea view....remember four years ago I was over the garbage and heard the wine
bottles being crunched at 5:00am? What a difference four stories about this hotel and a little help from my friend makes.
xoxo P
